sessions.summary: Set up ARI Vivo (vertical pace). Ingested the Vivo B2C Atendimento ROM (199 stories, 10 domains, 27-person/5-squad build, ~12.4k-29.8k productive hrs) as the primary grounding doc; ran full extraction audit (mostly Confirmed). Intent clarified: revalidate the ROM and produce a COMPLETE Salesforce PS project plan + role/hours estimate spanning all methodology phases, since the ROM prices Build/Delivery only. Also ingested the ARI nomination PS-Review Q&A (reference/ari-nomination-ps-review.{png,md}) — the business case.

ari_nomination.renewal: full, 3-year commitment, all contracts (incl. MCE) expire Jan/2028; customer commits to renew in exchange for starting work; work begins after renewal signed
ari_nomination.offer: Hands-on-Keyboard native conversational Agentforce Service Layer for B2C
success_criteria: single unified agentic front-end (eliminate Alt+Tab multi-window)

decisions.decision: ROM = Build/Delivery anchor only; wrap full PS lifecycle (P&D + SIT/UAT/Deploy/Scale + governance) around it
decisions.rationale: ROM explicitly excludes PM/governance and non-build phases; scoper needs complete profile+hours estimate. Recorded as decisions/0001.

open_threads: Confirm PS phase model (Prepare & Design, Build, SIT, UAT, Deploy, Scale/Hypercare)
Confirm phase-loading factors for non-build phases
Confirm hours basis: productive vs contracted (0.75/0.70)
Confirm traditional vs AI-native compression (biggest hours lever)
next_steps: Structure epics from ROM domains, then roadmap (full PS phases) + estimate (roles+hours all phases)

sessions.summary: Structured 10 epics (E01-E10) from the ROM domains (FND, OPS, CIM, CPM, CRM, PROCP, COPM, OMNI, SDP, INT) and ran full gap analysis: one epic-analyst per epic in gaps mode, grounded strictly in the ROM (knowledge/ empty). Produced 72 gaps across all 10 epics, merged idempotently into data/gaps.json + regenerated CSVs. completion_status.requirements = complete. Prerequisite for the user's grill-me-on-scope request.

gap_analysis.phase_0_basis: 72 gaps far exceeds the >15 threshold; source conflicts (1) below the >5 threshold but capability gaps (5) include missing transactional write clients (Party-master, Anatel sync) and the unmodeled interview engine
cross_cutting_themes: Experience-design discipline gap on every user-facing surface (V360 cockpit, 300-step interview, agentic capture, omnichannel console, Aliado) — none scoped; ties directly to the -15% TMA / +FCR ARI success criteria (G0405, G0505, G0607, G0807, G0908, G0306)

Governance discipline gap: no owner for regulated-flow change control, MCP cross-pillar contract versioning, routing-rule governance, AI-agent policy/audit, data stewardship/DSR (G0404, G0602, G0806, G0907, G0504, G1005)
No TMA/FCR baseline captured anywhere — the ARI's headline outcomes cannot be evidenced at go-live (G0507, G0903)
Pillar 2 MCP handoff contract undefined and load-bearing for PROCP+COPM (G0601, G0701) — the single Source Conflict
Cross-domain sequencing not reflected in the parallel-squad model: CPM-04 blocks on FND-04+INT-08; SDP agentic surface is downstream of S2/S3/S5 (G0403, G0904)
SCV/Amazon Connect telephony infra ownership external + Genesys EOL Dec-2027 hard window (G0105, G0802)
Capability gaps in the integration count: no Party-master WRITE client, no Anatel status-sync client (G1001, G1002, G0301)

friction: epic-analyst agents for E08 OMNI and E09 SDP each failed once with a sonnet-5 classifier/API timeout; both succeeded on immediate relaunch
open_threads: Recommend a Phase 0 (Prepare & Design refinement) to the client: model the CPM-04 interview engine, pin the Pillar 2 MCP contract, confirm MuleSoft facade inventory, capture TMA/FCR baseline, and decide experience-design + governance ownership
The 5 estimate levers still pending (PS phase model, loading factors, hours basis, traditional-vs-AI-native, reference scenario)
next_steps: Return to grill-me-on-scope (the user's explicit request) — stress-test persisted epics/gaps, revalidate ROM sizing bidirectionally, no value ceiling
Then confirm estimate levers and build the full PS-lifecycle role x phase x hours estimate

preferences.no_value_ceiling: The ARI AOV-at-risk (USD 10,281,553) is attrition context only — NOT a cap or target for the PS estimate. Size the estimate purely from scope (ROM + full PS lifecycle). Do not back-fit hours/price to the AOV.
